delivery_checks: An ad-hoc idea from Krish is built, shown to him, and queued only after he approves the exact payload.
Brand kit and an approved template only; every quote is a literal match to the published piece.
Where realistic synthetic media is present, apply the native AI label where the destination supports it; never add illustration boilerplate to public copy.
On YouTube a meme is a real video file, never a still posing as video.
Bind publication approval to the exact account, caption, ordered asset hashes, metadata and proposed time.
After a save, wait and independently reopen; reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying.
measurements: Dated exposed reach and meaningful engagement, preserving missing values.
Relevant follower/profile movement and source-attributed publication subscriptions where exposed.
24-hour, 72-hour and seven-day readback after actual publication; no financial ROI inference from draft counts.
